goal: Make the lane queue audit classify a closed claim as authored on main only when that claim's own reserved migration version was added by its merged pull request, with regression coverage for an unspent reservation and a later migration touching the same object.
dispatcher: Codex coordinating session relaying Albert's instruction to resolve six unblocked non-orchestrator issues
prohibited_actions: No database read, write, migration, preview action, or production action
No weakening of existing queue-audit refusals, claim collision locks, or migration version reservations
No issue closure or pull-request merge by this worker
assumptions: Issue #2406 remains open, unassigned, non-orchestrator, and has no linked open pull request
A migration version is authored by a claim only when that exact version was added by a merged pull request from the claim branch and remains on current main
stop_conditions: Stop if issue #2406 gains another live owner or linked implementation pull request
Stop if the repair would require a database change or weakening any existing refusal
